steps.label: sections
steps.expr: (() => { const pick = (el) => ({ h: Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().height), label: ((el.querySelector('h1,h2,h3')||{}).textContent||'').trim().slice(0,44) }); const secs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('section')).map(pick).filter(x=>x.h>40); const main = document.querySelector('main'); const kids = main ? Array.from(main.children).map(pick).filter(x=>x.h>40) : []; return { sections: secs, mainChildren: kids, mainHeight: main ? Math.round(main.getBoundingClientRect().height) : null, docHeight: document.documentElement.scrollHeight }; })()
